title: Speak Out of Turn: Safety Vulnerability of Large Language Models in Multi-turn Dialogue

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's willingness to generate hate speech and discriminatory content when subjected to multi-turn jailbreak attacks using the AdvBench dataset, scored by a GPT-4 prompt that assesses a 'violenceAndHateSpeechScore' and a 'harassmentAndBullyingScore'.
